text:
[IARC.3.2.1] Hosts the engine's Rete network and the consumption-loop
state machine that drives it (per [IARC.1.11]). When
pumped, drains what the integrator has asserted —
directly through the assert API, or by event-trace
replay; there is no engine-owned intake ([IARC.2.3])
— assigns `seq`, dispatches to recorder + wm + agenda
in order, runs fired activations through the
dispatcher, and returns. Breakpoint and step-state
introspection is the integrator's, over the
stream-event callback ([IARC.8.4]). Does not spawn threads, does not sleep,
does not block (per [IARC.1.10]).
